title: Sentinel Managed Security Tier Changes and Compliance Evidence Reporting: Training Notes
content:
These training notes set out the Sentinel Managed Security rules on moving between tiers, on compliance evidence reports for a client's declared framework, and on signed change requests.

## The rules

**Upgrades.** Upgrades take effect on the first day of the next calendar month after the client's signature and re-price both rates at the new tier's list rates less the discounts that apply on that date.

**Downgrades.** Downgrades take effect only at renewal.

**Status.** A tier change may take effect only while the subscription status is active.

**Compliance evidence reports.** A client whose declared compliance framework is not none receives compliance evidence reports only on a tier whose compliance evidence report frameworks list that framework; a client asking for evidence reports for its framework on a tier that does not list it must upgrade to the lowest tier that does.

**Signature.** Notices, withdrawals, tier changes and order cancellations are registered as change requests pending the authorized contact's signature and take effect only once signed.

## Questions answered by the rules

**When does a signed upgrade take effect?** On the first day of the next calendar month after the signature. With a hypothetical signature on 14 May, the upgrade takes effect on 1 June; a signature on 1 May also takes effect on 1 June.

**Which rates apply after an upgrade?** Both the workstation rate and the server rate are re-priced, at the new tier's list rates less the discounts that apply on the effective date, the first day of the next calendar month after the signature.

**Can a client move to a lower tier mid-term?** No. A downgrade takes effect only at renewal.

**Can a tier change take effect while monitoring is suspended or while a notice is in effect?** No. A tier change may take effect only while the subscription status is active.

| Subscription status on the effective date | May the tier change take effect? |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Ordered, deploying, suspended, notice given, closed or cancelled | No |

**What does a client receive whose framework is not listed by its current tier?** No compliance evidence reports for that framework on that tier; to receive them it must upgrade to the lowest tier whose list includes its framework.

**When does a change request take effect?** Only once the authorized contact has signed it; until then it is pending.
